profile.headline: Software Engineer at Southwest Airlines
profile.summary:
I build systems for people, bringing a community builder's understanding of how people work to the software I design, and an engineer's instincts to how I grow the teams and communities around it.

Seven years building on AWS, shipping cloud-native infrastructure and full-stack applications from early-stage startups to United Airlines. At United I drove on-prem to cloud backend migrations and led the resolution of 16,000+ CVEs across multiple teams. I work across the stack: React frontends, Python backends, ECS, Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, Terraform, and GitHub Actions CI/CD.

I architect and own maintainable systems so teams can move fast without worrying about what is underneath. I am comfortable walking into messy situations: I have taken over systems left by contractors, owned new applications and integrations end to end, and adapted across very different organizational scales and tech stacks. That ownership goes past app code into documentation, mentoring, and DevOps automation.

Outside of work I build tooling for the fighting game community: a tournament finder (FindMyFGC), a Discord bot that automates online event administration (adomi-san-bot), and documentation infrastructure that multiple event organizers now run on. I also grew a niche competitive community from under 100 to more than 200 players at majors by designing its events and formats, mentoring players, and personally leading the culture shift. It is the same instinct as my engineering work: understand the people on both ends of a system, build what they actually need, and the results follow.

I am looking for engineering or solutions roles where the work is deep, customer-focused problem solving. If that is what you are building, reach out and let's talk about what we can build.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect and implement AWS Lambda solution to process 300K+ Kafka messages per day ingested from legacy on-prem services to integrate existing data with new scalable cloud services

Migrate legacy on-prem service to AWS EKS and refactor to reduce latency by 50% while developing new features and new integrated services to support migration from legacy to cloud databases, using Kubernetes and Dynatrace for production monitoring and incident resolution

Lead and onboard newly formed team to coordinate vulnerability remediation across 3 teams, training engineers in secure code and managing biweekly releases to resolve 16,000+ vulnerabilities in a year across Java Spring and Python apps in AWS EKS and Lambda scanned by multiple security platforms
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python (Programming Language) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Vulnerability Management · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Developed UI for iPad app and became familiar with Swift and XCode. Led web development project using Angular.

positions.title: Cloud Platform Intern
positions.description: Worked as a part of the Cloud Platform team on an intern project extending a tool to help automate triaging of support tickets. Learned about cloud technologies and became familiar with Docker, Kubernetes, and deploying apps and services to the cloud.

positions.title: Peer Computing Consultant
positions.description: Maintained computer lab workstations and advised peers through computer or printing problems.

positions.title: UI Platform Intern
positions.description: Worked with UI Platform team on an intern project in which we created a seed app to help onboard new developers to the company's UI Platform, also creating a command line tool to generate the seed project as a starting point for developers. Became familiar with Javascript, AngularJS, EspressJS, and other tools with Node.js.
